_comment: Each output lists the TOP-LEVEL Photoshop groups that should be visible.
This is a whitelist -- anything not named here is hidden, so the purple
sample groups (icons orig, Location icons, icons small, the second Labels,
Ocean Orig) stay off on their own, and any new sample group will too.
Names must match the layer panel exactly; for duplicated names use 'Name#2'
to mean the second one from the top. Run `python scripts/build_map.py --list`
to print the live list from the PSD.
